fields.label: Provider Name
fields.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Production Minimax' or 'Dev OpenAI'.

fields.label: Provider Type
fields.description: Which LLM provider API to call. Determines the adapter used. NOTE: only 'minimax' is implemented in Slice 5 — the other options are reserved for future slices and will raise LLMError if selected until their adapter classes land. Adding a new option here requires both extending this Select AND adding a subclass + branch in frappe/friday_core/llm/provider.py.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Only active providers can be used. Inactive providers are skipped during fallback resolution.

fields.label: Auth Mode
fields.description: api_key = a static key in the API Key field (default). oauth = log in with a Claude Max / Codex subscription (design 63b-OAuth); the OAuth section below holds the encrypted tokens.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: The API key for this provider (required when Auth Mode = api_key). Stored encrypted at rest. Leave blank for OAuth providers.

fields.label: Base URL (optional)
fields.description: Override the provider's default API endpoint. Leave blank to use the adapter default. For Minimax the adapter default is https://api.minimax.io (international OpenAI-compat endpoint); override with https://api.minimaxi.com for the China endpoint. Also useful for proxies like OpenRouter.

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Model to use when the Agent Profile does not specify one. E.g. MiniMax-Standard, gpt-4o, claude-3-sonnet.

fields.label: Image Model
fields.description: MiniMax image model for the generate-image skill (e.g. image-01). Empty falls back to image-01.

fields.label: Default Temperature
fields.description: Sampling temperature. 0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = very random. Typical range: 0.0–1.0.

fields.label: Input Cost per 1M Tokens (USD)
fields.description: Operator-set rate used to compute LLM Usage Log.estimated_cost. Leave blank to skip cost estimation. (Hermes derives rates from a bundled pricing dataset; Friday keeps them on the provider row.)

fields.label: Output Cost per 1M Tokens (USD)
fields.description: Operator-set rate for output/completion tokens. Leave blank to skip cost estimation.

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Per-call wall-clock budget. Leave blank for the Hermes-parity default of 1800s (30 min) — appropriate for long goal-mode generations. Maps to httpx.Timeout.write and acts as an overall cap on the streaming session.

fields.label: Stream Stale Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Streaming watchdog — kills the call if no token arrives for this many seconds. Maps to httpx.Timeout.read. Default 120s matches Hermes's HERMES_STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT. This is the knob that actually fires on a hung provider; the request_timeout_seconds is the total-session cap behind it. Lower it for fast-fail; raise it for slow-prefill local providers.

fields.label: OAuth Flavor
fields.description: Which OAuth login this provider uses. anthropic-claude = Claude Pro/Max (Messages API). openai-codex = ChatGPT/Codex subscription (Responses API).

fields.label: OAuth Access Token
fields.description: Set by the login flow; refreshed automatically. Encrypted at rest.

fields.label: OAuth Refresh Token
fields.description: Used to renew the access token. Encrypted at rest.

fields.label: OAuth Account ID
fields.description: Codex ChatGPT-Account-ID (from the access-token JWT). Sent as a required header at inference time.

fields.label: OAuth PKCE Verifier (transient)
fields.description: Held only between starting and completing a login; cleared after the code exchange.

fields.label: OAuth State (transient)
fields.description: CSRF state held between starting and completing a login; cleared after exchange.

fields.label: OAuth Device Auth ID (transient)
fields.description: Codex device_auth_id held between starting the device login and a successful poll.
